tool_output.instruction: How can I create a formula in Excel that will display the sum of two horizontal cells in a third cell, only if both of the first two cells contain a value? tool_input.command:
cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
ws['C2'] = '=IF(AND(A2<>\"\",B2<>\"\"),A2+B2,\"\")'
ws['C3'] = '=IF(AND(A3<>\"\",B3<>\"\"),A3+B3,\"\")'
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
